relationships.description: Absent when the author declared none; the frontmatter schemas do not require the key, and the model must not require what the schema does not (FR-011-AC-15).

integrationMatrix.description: Optional: a repository whose subsystems do not integrate has none, and requiring the table would force an empty one.

coverageGaps.description: Optional: an absent register and an empty one are different claims, and only the second is authored.

description:
Root matrix record (archetype `TestMatrixIndex`, CR-039). A repository past a
certain size does not have one matrix; it has a tree, and this is the root.
It mints no test-case id, because `trace_targets.test-case` binds `TestMatrix`
and this is not one.
